result.summary: The page looks mostly functional and well-structured. One minor visual issue was identified related to a discount badge displaying potentially incorrect or ambiguous content.

issues.description: The discount badge on the pizza restaurant card at the bottom shows '-0%', which is visually meaningless and likely a data or rendering error. A 0% discount conveys no benefit and may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Only display a discount badge when the discount value is greater than 0%. Add a validation check to suppress the badge if the discount is 0 or null.
